author: Ninja26
quote: We've seen this game before—it's the same old, same old. It's really boring; it has no soul and nothing groundbreaking, not to mention the graphics. I wish I could have liked it more, but I'm really disappointed.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Ninja26
quote: The best game I've ever played. The open world is massive, the NPCs feel alive, the vegetation is stunning—everything feels organic. A masterclass.
